title: 第15章 病毒式宣传
content_zh:
华谊的宣传正式开始了。

    最先开始的论坛。

    天涯论坛上，一个帖子突然就火了。

    发帖的人自称是一个农村人，目前在京城上大学。

    他说，他所在的那个村子里，有一个恐怖传说。

    两个月前，一个导演带着两个演员，去他们村里拍摄这个恐怖传说，但之后再也没有这三人的消息了。

    帖子里说得极其玄乎。

    郭威是北航的大一学生，也看到了这个帖子，看到之后只是嗤笑一声。

    这种帖子每天都会冒出来很多，全都是假的。

    他在下面评论道：“傻波依才信。”

    然后，他就被爆破了。

    信与不信的人，在帖子下面吵成了一团，加上水军推波助澜，很快就出圈了。

    各种论坛，包括QQ上，都是在传播这个事情了。

    然后QQ上出现了‘转发给5个好友，否则会有厄运’的恐怖图片，进一步裂变。

    宣发效果强得可怕，连王忠磊这个始作俑者都很吃惊。

    他可没投多少钱呢，就出现了这种效果？

    不愧是好莱坞的先进经验啊。

    两天之后，开始有消息放出，说失踪的导演是陆穿，那两个演员是刘若瑛和刘晔。

    消息一出，瞬间就炸了。

    谣言进一步破圈，甚至纸媒也开始报道这件事情了，大众全部在寻找这三人的身影。

    不过这三人早被藏起来了。

    电影上映之前，这几个人，别想在公众面前亮相了。

    找不到这三人，议论声更大了。

    甚至有记者去采访这三人的亲戚朋友，得到的消息都是无可奉告。

    这下子，好像更确定了失踪的就是这三人。

    不用华谊如何公关，那些纸媒自发的就开始报道。

    华谊开始公关之后，新闻更是铺天盖地，网络上、纸媒、电视节目、线下，到处都在讨论三人的失踪和那个农村恐怖传说。

    甚至有三人的粉丝，直接去当地的警局报警。

    这讨论度，甚至都赶上《英雄》了。

    又过了两天，线下甚至出现了陆穿三人的寻人启事。
content_en:
Huayi's publicity has officially begun.

    The first forum to start with.

    On the Tianya Forum, a post suddenly became popular.

    The person who posted this claimed to be a rural person and is currently attending university in the capital.

    He said that there was a terrifying legend in the village where he lived.

    Two months ago, a director took two actors to their village to film this horrific legend, but there has been no news from these three people since then.

    The post is extremely confusing.

    Guo Wei, a freshman at Beihang University, also saw this post and just laughed after seeing it.

    There are a lot of posts like this popping up every day, and they are all fake.

    He commented below: "Only a silly boy would believe it."

    Then, he was blown away.

    People who believed it and those who didn't believed it got into a quarrel under the post, and with trolls adding fuel to the flames, they soon left the circle.

    Various forums, including QQ, are spreading this matter.

    Then the horrifying picture of ‘Forward to 5 friends, otherwise there will be bad luck’ appeared on QQ, causing further fission.

    The propaganda effect was so powerful that even the instigator Wang Zhonglei was surprised.

    He didn't invest much money, and this effect occurred?

    It is indeed an advanced experience in Hollywood.

    Two days later, news began to leak out that the missing director was Lu Chuan, and the two actors were Liu Ruoying and Liu Ye.

    As soon as the news came out, it exploded instantly.

    The rumors spread further, and even print media began to report on the matter. The public was looking for these three people.

    But these three people have long been hidden.

    Before the movie is released, these people don't even think about appearing in public.

    The three people could not be found, and the discussion became even louder.

    Some reporters even went to interview relatives and friends of these three people, but the information they received was unavailable.

    Now, it seems more certain that the missing people are these three people.

    Huayi didn't need any public relations, the print media started reporting on it spontaneously.

    After Huayi started public relations, the news was overwhelming. The disappearance of the three people and the terrifying legend in the countryside were discussed everywhere on the Internet, in print media, on TV programs, and offline.

    Fans of the three people even went directly to the local police station to call the police.

    This level of discussion has even caught up with "Heroes".

    Two days later, a missing persons notice for Lu Chuan and the others even appeared offline.
